_audit_note: Evidence classification tags applied to each field: [PE]=Physically Established, [SP]=Standard/Procedure Dependent, [FA]=Facility/ATE Dependent, [SA]=Synthetic Assumption, [UA]=Unknown/Requires Authoritative Documentation

DIGITAL_IC._note: Covers CMOS logic ICs, FPGAs, ASICs screened for space qualification.

IDDQ.evidence: [PE] Arrhenius thermal leakage I∝exp(-Ea/kT); gate oxide defect current

input_leakage.evidence: [PE] Junction leakage from ESD input diodes

physical_failure_modes.GATE_OXIDE_BREAKDOWN: [PE] Intrinsic dielectric breakdown; Weibull distributed; accelerated by E-field
physical_failure_modes.ELECTROMIGRATION: [PE] Black's equation: MTTF∝j^{-n}·exp(Ea_em/kT); Ea_em≈0.7-0.9eV Al, ≈1.1eV Cu
physical_failure_modes.HOT_CARRIER_INJECTION: [PE] HCI: electrons/holes injected into gate oxide at high lateral E-field
physical_failure_modes.NBTI: [PE] Negative Bias Temperature Instability in PMOS; threshold voltage drift ΔVth∝t^0.25

model_routing.evidence: [SA] Model assigned based on Arrhenius physical basis; validated on synthetic IDDQ lots

MEMS_GYROSCOPE.display_name: MEMS Angular Rate Sensor / Inertial Measurement Unit
MEMS_GYROSCOPE._note: Covers silicon MEMS rate sensors; failure modes differ fundamentally from ICs. ZRO drift is the primary reliability indicator [PE]. Not screened identically to ICs [SP].

zero_rate_offset.evidence: [PE] Zero-rate output (ZRO) drift: packaging stress relaxation + spring constant drift

scale_factor_error.evidence: [PE] Sensitivity/scale-factor drift from capacitive comb geometry changes

noise_density.evidence: [PE] Thermomechanical noise floor; kT/C with spring constant

supply_current.evidence: [SP] Supply current drawn; measured as secondary health indicator

temperature_sensitivity.evidence: [PE] ZRO thermal dependency; CTE mismatch between die and package

physical_failure_modes.MEMS_STICTION: [PE] Comb finger stiction from surface adhesion forces exceeding restoring spring force
physical_failure_modes.PACKAGING_STRESS_RELAXATION: [PE] Viscoelastic creep in die attach / resin; shifts ZRO permanently
physical_failure_modes.CAPACITIVE_COMB_DRIFT: [PE] Geometry micro-deformation of comb structure under thermal cycling
physical_failure_modes.HERMETICITY_LOSS: [SP] Package seal degradation; cavity pressure change alters damping [SP ESCC 10501]

model_routing.evidence: [SA] Assigned based on viscoelastic creep physical basis; validated on synthetic MEMS ZRO lots

IMAGE_SENSOR.display_name: Space-Grade CMOS Image Sensor / Focal Plane Array
IMAGE_SENSOR._note: Space-grade CMOS imagers accumulate radiation-induced dark current over mission life. Thermal dark current dominates pre-launch screening [PE]. Hot-pixel count is a key reliability indicator.

dark_current_density.evidence: [PE] Thermal e-h generation in depletion region; ∝exp(-Eg/2kT); strongly temperature dependent

DSNU.evidence: [PE] Dark Signal Non-Uniformity: spatial variation of dark current across pixel array

hot_pixel_count.evidence: [PE] Pixels with dark current >10x median; localized crystal defect sites

dark_signal_mean.evidence: [PE] Mean dark signal accumulation per integration time; temperature sensitive

physical_failure_modes.DARK_CURRENT_SPIKE_GROWTH: [PE] Depletion region Shockley-Read-Hall generation at lattice defect sites
physical_failure_modes.TRAP_ASSISTED_TUNNELING: [PE] Trap-to-band and band-to-band tunneling at high E-field pixel nodes
physical_failure_modes.PIXEL_TRANSFER_GATE_LEAKAGE: [PE] Transfer gate threshold drift from interface trap buildup
physical_failure_modes.RADIATION_DISPLACEMENT_DAMAGE: [SP] Proton/heavy-ion damage creating recombination centers; NASA handbook [SP GSFC-STD-7000]

hot_pixel_count_max.evidence: [SA] Synthetic threshold; mission image quality requirement [UA]

model_routing.evidence: [SA] Assigned based on SRH dark current physical basis; validated on synthetic imager lots
